records.context: :func:`analyse_divisions` works in frames and pixels. With the movie's frame interval, times gain ``_min`` columns (``t_div_min``, ``t_birth_min``, ``t_division_min``, ``duration_min``, ``rel_t_min``); with its pixel size, areas gain ``_um2`` and lengths ``_um`` columns; with both, speed gains ``_um_per_min`` columns. The frame and pixel columns stay. Every effect and trajectory row gets the unit of its change, and the summary the calibration, the units, ``window_min``, ``median_cycle_min`` and ``units_note``. A missing value is never guessed: those results stay in frames or pixels and ``units_note`` says which. Calling it again replaces the earlier calibration.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.calibrate_divisions#1
records.source: :func:`analyse_divisions` works in frames and pixels. With the movie's frame interval, times gain ``_min`` columns (``t_div_min``, ``t_birth_min``, ``t_division_min``, ``duration_min``, ``rel_t_min``); with its pixel size, areas gain ``_um2`` and lengths ``_um`` columns; with both, speed gains ``_um_per_min`` columns. The frame and pixel columns stay. Every effect and trajectory row gets the unit of its change, and the summary the calibration, the units, ``window_min``, ``median_cycle_min`` and ``units_note``. A missing value is never guessed: those results stay in frames or pixels and ``units_note`` says which. Calling it again replaces the earlier calibration.
records.translation: :func:`analyse_divisions` trabalha em quadros e pixels. Com o intervalo entre quadros do filme, os tempos ganham colunas ``_min`` (``t_div_min``, ``t_birth_min``, ``t_division_min``, ``duration_min``, ``rel_t_min``); com o tamanho de pixel, as áreas ganham colunas ``_um2`` e os comprimentos, colunas ``_um``; com ambos, a velocidade ganha colunas ``_um_per_min``. As colunas em quadros e pixels permanecem. Cada linha de efeito e de trajetória recebe a unidade da sua variação, e o resumo recebe a calibração, as unidades, ``window_min``, ``median_cycle_min`` e ``units_note``. Um valor ausente nunca é adivinhado: esses resultados permanecem em quadros ou pixels e ``units_note`` indica quais. Chamá-la novamente substitui a calibração anterior.

records.source: Hedges' g with a cell and a movie bootstrap interval.
records.translation: Hedges' g com um intervalo bootstrap por células e outro por filmes.

records.context: :func:`effect_size` gives g and the cell interval, drawn first from the same generator, so with one movie the result is the cell result. Cells of one movie share its imaging and are not independent, so a second interval resamples movies with replacement, keeps all of a drawn movie's treated and control values and recomputes g. From ``min_movies`` movies on it is the reported interval; with fewer it is shown beside the cell one, and one movie has no movie interval.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.movie_effect_size#1
records.source: :func:`effect_size` gives g and the cell interval, drawn first from the same generator, so with one movie the result is the cell result. Cells of one movie share its imaging and are not independent, so a second interval resamples movies with replacement, keeps all of a drawn movie's treated and control values and recomputes g. From ``min_movies`` movies on it is the reported interval; with fewer it is shown beside the cell one, and one movie has no movie interval.
records.translation: :func:`effect_size` fornece g e o intervalo por células, sorteados primeiro a partir do mesmo gerador, de modo que, com um único filme, o resultado é o resultado por células. As células de um filme compartilham a sua aquisição de imagens e não são independentes; por isso, um segundo intervalo reamostra filmes com reposição, mantém todos os valores tratados e de controle de um filme sorteado e recalcula g. A partir de ``min_movies`` filmes, este é o intervalo relatado; com menos, ele é mostrado ao lado do intervalo por células, e um único filme não tem intervalo por filmes.

records.context: Pool several movies' division analyses, with intervals that resample movies.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.pool_division_movies#0
records.source: Pool several movies' division analyses, with intervals that resample movies.
records.translation: Combinar as análises de divisão de vários filmes, com intervalos que reamostram filmes.

records.context: Every movie's unit changes (the ``changes`` table of :func:`analyse_divisions`) are put together and compared again as Hedges' g (:func:`movie_effect_size` with the movie of every unit), so from ``min_movies`` movies on the interval resamples movies rather than cells; with fewer the cell interval is reported and the movie one shown beside it, and one movie has no movie interval. Log-ratio changes have no unit. Speed changes are pooled in um/min when every movie has its frame interval and pixel size, else in px/frame, and ``units_note`` says so. Trajectories are pooled frame by frame when the movies share a frame interval (or none has one); cycles are pooled with their movie and the size control is refitted, in um^2 when every movie has its pixel size.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.pool_division_movies#1
records.source: Every movie's unit changes (the ``changes`` table of :func:`analyse_divisions`) are put together and compared again as Hedges' g (:func:`movie_effect_size` with the movie of every unit), so from ``min_movies`` movies on the interval resamples movies rather than cells; with fewer the cell interval is reported and the movie one shown beside it, and one movie has no movie interval. Log-ratio changes have no unit. Speed changes are pooled in um/min when every movie has its frame interval and pixel size, else in px/frame, and ``units_note`` says so. Trajectories are pooled frame by frame when the movies share a frame interval (or none has one); cycles are pooled with their movie and the size control is refitted, in um^2 when every movie has its pixel size.
records.translation: As variações por unidade de cada filme (a tabela ``changes`` de :func:`analyse_divisions`) são reunidas e comparadas novamente como Hedges' g (:func:`movie_effect_size` com o filme de cada unidade), de modo que, a partir de ``min_movies`` filmes, o intervalo reamostra filmes em vez de células; com menos, o intervalo por células é relatado e o por filmes é mostrado ao lado dele, e um único filme não tem intervalo por filmes. As variações de razão logarítmica não têm unidade. As variações de velocidade são combinadas em um/min quando todos os filmes têm o seu intervalo entre quadros e o seu tamanho de pixel; caso contrário, em px/frame, e ``units_note`` indica isso. As trajetórias são combinadas quadro a quadro quando os filmes compartilham um intervalo entre quadros (ou nenhum tem um); os ciclos são combinados com o seu filme e o controle de tamanho é reajustado, em um^2 quando todos os filmes têm o seu tamanho de pixel.

records.context: Fetch a public imaging dataset and check it against the archive's file list.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#0
records.source: Fetch a public imaging dataset and check it against the archive's file list.
records.translation: Baixar um conjunto de dados de imagem público e verificá-lo em relação à lista de arquivos do repositório.

records.context: A reanalysis of a public application view starts with a transfer of hundreds of gigabytes to several terabytes. Interrupted transfers leave files that look present: a zero-byte TIFF, a truncated ZIP, or a full-size file that lftp was still filling in when it stopped (it keeps a ``.lftp-pget-status`` file beside it). A processing session started on such a mirror fails hours later, or loses a microplate sample position without failing. This module finds those files before the processing session starts, and fetches only them.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#1
records.source: A reanalysis of a public screen starts with a transfer of hundreds of gigabytes to several terabytes. Interrupted transfers leave files that look present: a zero-byte TIFF, a truncated ZIP, or a full-size file that lftp was still filling in when it stopped (it keeps a ``.lftp-pget-status`` file beside it). A run started on such a mirror fails hours later, or loses a well without failing. This module finds those files before the run starts, and fetches only them.
records.translation: Uma reanálise de uma triagem pública começa com uma transferência de centenas de gigabytes a vários terabytes. Transferências interrompidas deixam arquivos que parecem presentes: um TIFF de zero bytes, um ZIP truncado ou um arquivo de tamanho completo que o lftp ainda estava preenchendo quando parou (ele mantém um arquivo ``.lftp-pget-status`` ao lado). Uma execução iniciada sobre um espelho assim falha horas depois, ou perde um poço sem falhar. Este módulo encontra esses arquivos antes do início da execução e baixa apenas eles.

records.context: Parallelism is across files, not within one file: an archive of many TIFFs keeps every worker busy, and a single large ZIP is resumed rather than split. The worker count is clamped by :func:`spacr.resource_log._guard_workers`.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#10
records.source: Parallelism is across files, not within one file: an archive of many TIFFs keeps every worker busy, and a single large ZIP is resumed rather than split. The worker count is clamped by :func:`spacr.resource_log._guard_workers`.
records.translation: O paralelismo ocorre entre arquivos, não dentro de um arquivo: um repositório com muitos TIFFs mantém todos os processos de trabalho ocupados, e um único ZIP grande é retomado em vez de dividido. O número de processos de trabalho é limitado por :func:`spacr.resource_log._guard_workers`.

records.context: The file list (the manifest) is a TSV, CSV or JSON table with a path column and, where the archive publishes them, a size and an MD5 or SHA-256 column, or a text file with one address per line (the form of the 2026-10-31 ``bbbc021_urls.txt``). Without a file list, a BioImage Archive or IDR folder is listed over FTP, which gives every file's size, and a BBBC folder from its web index.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#7
records.source: The file list (the manifest) is a TSV, CSV or JSON table with a path column and, where the archive publishes them, a size and an MD5 or SHA-256 column, or a text file with one address per line (the form of the 2026-10-31 ``bbbc021_urls.txt``). Without a file list, a BioImage Archive or IDR folder is listed over FTP, which gives every file's size, and a BBBC folder from its web index.
records.translation: A lista de arquivos (o manifesto) é uma tabela TSV, CSV ou JSON com uma coluna de caminho e, quando o repositório os publica, uma coluna de tamanho e uma de MD5 ou SHA-256, ou um arquivo de texto com um endereço por linha (o formato do ``bbbc021_urls.txt`` de 2026-10-31). Sem uma lista de arquivos, uma pasta do BioImage Archive ou do IDR é listada via FTP, o que fornece o tamanho de cada arquivo, e uma pasta do BBBC, a partir do seu índice web.

records.context: :func:`check_completeness` compares the local folder with the manifest and gives every file one status: ``ok``, ``missing``, ``empty`` (zero bytes), ``short`` or ``long`` (size differs from the archive's), ``checksum`` (published checksum differs), ``partial`` (a leftover ``.part``, ``.partial``, ``.aspx`` or ``.lftp-pget-status`` file beside it), ``corrupt_zip`` (a ZIP whose directory cannot be read) or ``extra`` (on disk, not in the manifest). :func:`fetch_dataset` runs that check, fetches every file that is not ``ok`` with ranged, resumed transfers and retries, checks again and writes the manifest, the table and a summary under ``_spacr_dataset_check`` in the destination. Executing it again fetches only what is still missing or bad.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#8
records.source: :func:`check_completeness` compares the local folder with the manifest and gives every file one status: ``ok``, ``missing``, ``empty`` (zero bytes), ``short`` or ``long`` (size differs from the archive's), ``checksum`` (published checksum differs), ``partial`` (a leftover ``.part``, ``.partial``, ``.aspx`` or ``.lftp-pget-status`` file beside it), ``corrupt_zip`` (a ZIP whose directory cannot be read) or ``extra`` (on disk, not in the manifest). :func:`fetch_dataset` runs that check, fetches every file that is not ``ok`` with ranged, resumed transfers and retries, checks again and writes the manifest, the table and a summary under ``_spacr_dataset_check`` in the destination. Running it again fetches only what is still missing or bad.
records.translation: :func:`check_completeness` compara a pasta local com o manifesto e atribui a cada arquivo um status: ``ok``, ``missing``, ``empty`` (zero bytes), ``short`` ou ``long`` (o tamanho difere do informado pelo repositório), ``checksum`` (a soma de verificação publicada difere), ``partial`` (um arquivo ``.part``, ``.partial``, ``.aspx`` ou ``.lftp-pget-status`` remanescente ao lado), ``corrupt_zip`` (um ZIP cujo diretório não pode ser lido) ou ``extra`` (no disco, mas não no manifesto). :func:`fetch_dataset` executa essa verificação, baixa cada arquivo que não está ``ok`` com transferências por intervalos de bytes, retomadas e com novas tentativas, verifica novamente e grava o manifesto, a tabela e um resumo em ``_spacr_dataset_check`` no destino. Executá-la novamente baixa apenas o que ainda está ausente ou com defeito.

records.context: Each transfer writes to ``<name>.<process id>.part`` and renames it into place only when it is complete, so two processes fetching into one folder never rename each other's file away. A ``.part`` left by a process that has stopped is taken over and resumed from its last byte.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets#9
records.source: Each transfer writes to ``<name>.<process id>.part`` and renames it into place only when it is complete, so two processes fetching into one folder never rename each other's file away. A ``.part`` left by a process that has stopped is taken over and resumed from its last byte.
records.translation: Cada transferência grava em ``<name>.<process id>.part`` e só renomeia o arquivo para o seu lugar definitivo quando ele está completo, de modo que dois processos que baixam para a mesma pasta nunca renomeiam o arquivo um do outro. Um ``.part`` deixado por um processo que parou é assumido e retomado a partir do seu último byte.

records.context: A ``.json`` file holds a list of records, or a key-value mapping with the list under ``files``; a ``.txt`` or ``.urls`` file holds one address per line (blank lines and lines starting with ``#`` are skipped); anything else is read with :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, so TSV, CSV, Parquet and Excel all work. Column names are matched without regard to case: ``path`` (or ``Files``, ``file``, ``name``), ``url``, ``size`` (or ``bytes``), ``md5`` and ``sha256``. Directory rows of a BioImage Archive JSON list are skipped.
records.label: spacr.public_datasets.read_manifest#1
records.source: A ``.json`` file holds a list of records, or a dict with the list under ``files``; a ``.txt`` or ``.urls`` file holds one address per line (blank lines and lines starting with ``#`` are skipped); anything else is read with :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, so TSV, CSV, Parquet and Excel all work. Column names are matched without regard to case: ``path`` (or ``Files``, ``file``, ``name``), ``url``, ``size`` (or ``bytes``), ``md5`` and ``sha256``. Directory rows of a BioImage Archive JSON list are skipped.
records.translation: Um arquivo ``.json`` contém uma lista de registros, ou um dict com a lista em ``files``; um arquivo ``.txt`` ou ``.urls`` contém um endereço por linha (linhas em branco e linhas que começam com ``#`` são ignoradas); qualquer outro é lido com :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, de modo que TSV, CSV, Parquet e Excel funcionam. Os nomes das colunas são comparados sem distinção entre maiúsculas e minúsculas: ``path`` (ou ``Files``, ``file``, ``name``), ``url``, ``size`` (ou ``bytes``), ``md5`` e ``sha256``. As linhas de diretório de uma lista JSON do BioImage Archive são ignoradas.
